item.title: Drawdown® Roadmap
item.description: The Drawdown® Roadmap is a science-based strategy for accelerating climate solutions. It points to which climate actions governments, businesses, investors, philanthropists, community organizations, and others should prioritize to make the most of our efforts to stop climate change.

item.title: Protect Seaweed Ecosystems - Figure 2
item.description: Protect Seaweed Ecosystems - Figure 2 Figure 2. Overview of a seaweed ecosystem showing carbon fluxes into and out of the ecosystem that can result in carbon removal. Some carbon is exported to the shallow sea, where it may be recycled or persist for longer periods depending on its form, some is exported to the deep sea (~1000 m), and some is buried in seafloor sediments.
